description:
## Why This Exists

commands/xget.rs::handle_xget() fetches raw IPFS block bytes for any client that provides a known article CID. The msgid_map check prevents fetching arbitrary IPFS blocks, but there is no requirement that the session be authenticated or TLS-protected before calling XGET. On a server with posting_allowed=false and auth_required=false (read-only open server), any unauthenticated client on any connection (plain or TLS) can retrieve raw IPLD blocks by CID.

For a private deployment where article content is sensitive, this may be an unintended capability. XGET is an X-prefixed extension and should at minimum require a TLS connection when TLS is configured.

## Acceptance Criteria

Document the intended access policy for XGET. At minimum, if TLS is configured, require a TLS connection for XGET. Consider requiring authentication.
title: xget.rs: XGET not gated on TLS or auth — any plain-text session can fetch blocks
